meta.title: Reasoning Pruning — Architecture
meta.description: A research toolkit that trains LLM reasoning models on their own pruned, compressed transition paths (x -> y). A generator G produces step-by-step traces, a decision auditor D identifies the first safely skippable span, and the extracted (x -> y) transitions become a Hugging Face dataset used to QLoRA fine-tune a compressed model G'. Ships as a composable Python library with a Typer CLI (`rp`), an interactive Colab notebook, and a Gradio visualizer.

nodes.label: Typer CLI (rp)
nodes.description: Thin command shell over the core tools: `rp datagen try/build`, `rp train`, `rp eval`, `rp view`. Parses flags, prints Rich summaries, wires optional --push-to-hf publishing.

nodes.label: Exploration Notebook
nodes.description: Interactive 11-stage research lab: environment bootstrap, benchmark spectrum streaming, live trace generation, overthinking audits, HTML diffs, dataset construction/validation, and Hub sync. Calls every tool through the package API as `rp.*`.

nodes.label: Package Public API
nodes.description: Root module re-exporting all 15+ composable tools and 7 dataclasses. Importing it auto-runs init_environment() so credentials and defaults are ready for every downstream caller.

nodes.label: Config & Env Init
nodes.description: Loads .env files (repo, /content for Colab), normalizes token aliases (GEMINI_TOKEN -> GEMINI_API_KEY, HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN -> HF_TOKEN), defaults generator G to google/gemma-4-12B-it, and dynamically resolves decision auditor D per available provider credentials.

nodes.label: Core Dataclasses
nodes.description: Shared structured contracts passed between all layers: ReasoningTrace, PruneDecision, TransitionExample, RolloutResult, TrainResult, EvalSample, EvalResult — each with to_dict/from_dict serialization.

nodes.label: Generation & Rollout
nodes.description: Generator-model engine: generate_trace prompts G via LiteLLM (with prefix continuation), rollout_pruning iterates generate -> audit -> extract up to max_depth building the growing pruned prefix, and extract_transition forms the (x -> y) SFT pair.

nodes.label: Decision Auditor D
nodes.description: LLM reasoning auditor: find_first_skip formats indexed steps + rubric prompt, calls D through LiteLLM, parses/validates the JSON verdict (bounds checks, no full-trace skips), and returns a PruneDecision with skip indices, skipped text, next step, and rationale.

nodes.label: Step Segmenter
nodes.description: Pure-stdlib text segmentation: decomposes raw completions into discrete addressable steps s_1..s_n using auto-detected numbered markers, paragraphs, linebreaks, or sentence boundaries (decimal-safe regex).

nodes.label: PT Dataset Builder
nodes.description: Ingests real questions (load_benchmark_questions / load_spectrum_benchmarks across a 9-entry BENCHMARK_REGISTRY with offline curated fallback), fans out parallel rollout_pruning via ThreadPoolExecutor, injects provenance metadata, and packages TransitionExamples into a datasets.Dataset (build_pt_dataset / load_pt_dataset).

nodes.label: HF Hub Sync
nodes.description: Publishes versioned artifacts with automated lineage documentation: push_dataset_to_hf uploads PT datasets plus a generated Dataset Card (depth breakdown), push_model_to_hf uploads adapters plus a Model Card embedding EvalResult metrics.

nodes.label: QLoRA SFT Trainer
Dual-Model Evaluator
nodes.description: Runs base G and pruned G' side-by-side on benchmark questions via generate_trace, extracts answers ('#### n', \boxed{}, last-number fallback), scores correctness against gold, and computes token savings % and accuracy delta into an EvalResult.

nodes.label: Visualizer & Viewer
nodes.description: Qualitative inspection surfaces: render_trace_diff (Rich terminal panel or self-contained notebook HTML with PRUNED/NEXT-USEFUL annotations), render_comparison (Base vs Pruned cards), and launch_viewer (Gradio dashboard with live pruning playground and dataset browser).

nodes.label: LLM Providers (LiteLLM)
nodes.description: Unified completion gateway serving both roles: Generator G (trace generation) and Decision auditor D (skip auditing). Default models resolved by config: gemini/gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-haiku, deepseek-chat, or huggingface/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.

nodes.label: HF Hub — Datasets
nodes.description: Source of benchmark questions (openai/gsm8k, allenai/ai2_arc, tau/commonsense_qa, hotpotqa/hotpot_qa, ChilleD/SVAMP, rajpurkar/squad_v2, allenai/sciq, allenai/openbookqa — streamed, not downloaded) and destination for published PT dataset repos.

nodes.label: HF Hub — Models
nodes.description: Supplies base checkpoints (e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) for QLoRA loading and hosts released pruned-model adapter repos with lineage Model Cards.

nodes.label: Local Artifacts
nodes.description: On-disk state: .env credentials consumed by config, Arrow datasets saved at ./data/rp_dataset (save_path), and LoRA checkpoints/adapters under ./checkpoints/rp_model/final_adapter.

nodes.label: Weights & Biases
nodes.description: Optional experiment-tracking backend enabled via TrainingArguments(report_to='wandb') when rp train --report-to wandb is set.

flows.name: Pruning Trial (CLI)
flows.description: `rp datagen try` — end-to-end single-question rollout with terminal diff visualization

steps.details: Parses -q/--benchmark flags; if no question is given, samples one from a benchmark registry alias.
load_benchmark_questions streams one real question + gold answer (curated fallback when offline).
rollout_pruning loops generate_trace -> grow pruned prefix -> recurse to --max-depth; computes compression_ratio from original vs final step counts.
find_first_skip sends indexed steps + rubric to D; validates JSON indices, blocks full-trace skips, returns PruneDecision with reason.
on_step callback prints a Rich panel per depth (green prefix / struck-through PRUNED / cyan target); CLI prints compression summary.

flows.name: Interactive Research Lab (Colab)
flows.description: Notebook-driven exploration across the full reasoning spectrum, stage by stage

steps.details: Detects Colab vs local, installs deps, imports the library as `rp`.
Package import triggers init_environment(); all tools available as rp.*.
load_spectrum_benchmarks streams 6 benchmark families: math, science, commonsense, multi-hop, extractive QA.
generate_trace produces ReasoningTrace objects; rollout_pruning recurses multi-depth on complex problems.
find_first_skip identifies the first redundant span with a written justification.
render_trace_diff(as_html=True) displays annotated diffs; build_pt_dataset output validated against schema constraints.

flows.name: PT Dataset Build & Publish (CLI)
flows.description: `rp datagen build` — turn benchmark questions into a versioned Hugging Face training dataset

steps.details: Resolves --dataset ('gsm8k' or 'spectrum'), --workers, --max-depth, optional --push-to-hf repo id.
Benchmark loaders normalize multiple-choice options, contexts, and ground truths into uniform question dicts.
ThreadPoolExecutor runs rollout_pruning per question; provenance metadata (category, source_dataset, ground_truth) injected into transitions.
Each depth yields a TransitionExample: input_x (question + useful prefix) -> target_y (next useful step), plus skipped_steps and skip_reason.
Dataset saved as Arrow files under ./data/rp_dataset.
push_dataset_to_hf computes depth breakdown and uploads an auto-generated Dataset Card.
Versioned PT dataset goes live on the Hub (e.g. user/rp-gsm8k-qwen1.5b-v1).

flows.name: QLoRA Fine-Tuning (GPU)
flows.description: `rp train` — compress G into G' via SFT on pruning transitions

steps.details: Forwards --epochs, --batch-size, --lr, --lora-r, --report-to to the trainer.
Resolves local Arrow folder or HF repo for the dataset; loads AutoModelForCausalLM with NF4 BitsAndBytesConfig (4-bit, double quant).
Downloads e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct weights and tokenizer.
trainer.model.save_pretrained -> ./checkpoints/rp_model/final_adapter (+ tokenizer).
push_model_to_hf uploads the adapter folder and writes a lineage Model Card (base model, method, eval metrics).
Pruned-model repo live on the Hub (e.g. user/qwen1.5b-rp-v1).

flows.name: Base vs Pruned Evaluation (CLI)
flows.description: `rp eval` — verify compression did not sacrifice accuracy

steps.details: Takes base vs pruned identifiers, benchmark name, --max-samples.
datasets.load_dataset(benchmark, split='test') supplies questions and gold answers; loops samples with tqdm.
generate_trace called once per model per question; token counts captured from usage metadata.
Both G (verbose baseline) and G' (pruned) routed through LiteLLM.
Console metrics table; render_comparison renders side-by-side cards; token savings % and accuracy delta summarized.

flows.name: Live Gradio Playground
flows.description: `rp view --share` — interactive browser dashboard for pruning demos

steps.details: `rp view` optionally loads a PT dataset before starting the server; --share exposes a public URL (Colab-friendly).
load_pt_dataset resolves a local Arrow folder or Hub repo for the Dataset Browser tab.
Tabs: Live Pruning Playground (question input, model dropdowns, depth slider) and Dataset Browser (JSON inspector).
Submitted question runs rollout_pruning live inside the browser session.
Per-depth PruneDecisions rendered as stacked HTML diff cards with a compression summary.

flows.name: Credential Bootstrap & Defaults
flows.description: How every entry point gets working credentials and sensible default models

steps.details: Any entry point (notebook cell, CLI process) importing reasoning_pruning triggers package initialization.
init_environment scans standard .env locations and normalizes aliases (GEMINI_TOKEN -> GEMINI_API_KEY, HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN -> HF_TOKEN).
Keys discovered in repo/.env or /content/.env via dotenv or a built-in fallback parser; never crashes when absent.
get_default_generator_model resolves google/gemma-4-12B-it; get_default_decision_model picks provider models by priority: gemini-2.5-flash -> gpt-4o-mini -> claude-3-5-haiku -> deepseek -> HF Qwen.
